compare.heading: Compare with Lidarr
compare.description: Compare the source library and Lidarr file indexes
compare.title: File counts · compare with Lidarr
compare.localCounts: Indexed as present: {sources} · Expired records: {expired} · Outputs: {outputs} · Failed sources: {failed}
compare.countHint: Counts refer to files, not album track listings. Failed sources still count as present; outputs include retained expired files. Cover images and unsupported extensions are excluded from source counts.
compare.connectionHint: Use the URL reachable from MusicForge. Find the API key in Lidarr Settings → General. A blank key keeps the saved key for the same URL; an empty URL disconnects and clears the key.
compare.scopeHint: Comparison uses the Lidarr path prefix in Settings to map the same source directory. It only reads API file lists and the MusicForge index; audio is not downloaded.
compare.failed: Comparison incomplete — no reliable difference list is available.
compare.snapshotHint: This is an index snapshot, not a live disk check. Files not indexed are not necessarily missing. After imports or scans finish, compare again. Re-scanning selected directories uses the existing scan/build queue.
compare.outsideHint: Some Lidarr paths are outside the configured prefix. Check the mapping and other Lidarr root folders before interpreting the count difference.
compare.selectPage: Select re-scannable files on this page
compare.scanQueued: Selected directories queued for scanning. Compare again after the scan finishes.
compare.help.not_indexed: Lidarr lists this file but MusicForge has no source record. Re-scan its directory; if it remains absent, check the path mapping and mount visibility.
compare.help.expired: Lidarr still lists this path, while MusicForge previously marked it absent. Re-scan the directory to check whether it has returned.
compare.help.unsupported: Lidarr lists this file but the current MusicForge scanner does not accept its extension.
compare.help.not_in_lidarr: MusicForge indexes this path, but Lidarr does not list it as imported. Check Lidarr’s import status, root folders and path mapping.
compare.help.unmapped: Lidarr knows this file but has not matched it to a track. Resolve its mapping in Lidarr; MusicForge can index supported files independently.
compare.help.failed: Both applications list the file. This is a processing error, not a source-count difference. Open the track or task to inspect and retry it.
compare.help.possibly_damaged: The output was imported by best-effort repair. It counts as an output but remains marked possibly damaged.
compare.help.no_output: Both applications list the source. Check its verification or conversion queue in MusicForge.
compare.help.outside_scope: This Lidarr path does not map to the configured source root. It is excluded from the comparable Lidarr count. Check other Lidarr root folders and the path prefix in MusicForge Settings.

lyrics.title: LRC lyrics
lyrics.recommendationHint: When results finish loading, a suitable match is previewed automatically without changing your selection. Higher scores come first, then your source priority; ties within a source favor Simplified Chinese originals and translations. Scores compare title, artist, album and duration, not the probability of a correct match. Check the recording and timing before saving.
lyrics.cacheHint: Results are kept for up to seven days, even across restarts. Use Force new search when you want fresh results.
lyrics.inventory: Available {found} · No match {missing} · Instrumental {instrumental} · Review {review} · Failed {failed} · Unchecked {unchecked}
lyrics.inventoryHint: Latest check for each playable artifact; repeated checks count once. Independent of the filters below.
lyrics.hint: Tracks with suitable lyrics are skipped. For the rest, MusicForge checks a same-name source LRC first, then enabled online sources; ties follow your priority order. Unregistered files and lyrics you edited are kept.
lyrics.privacy: Online searches send track metadata only to enabled providers. Automatic matching uses the saved score threshold and checks title, artist and recording version.
lyrics.automatic: Automatically fill lyrics for new and existing artifacts
lyrics.started: Lyric maintenance started. View progress in LRC Lyrics or Lyrics settings.
lyrics.nothingPending: No lyrics need filling. Existing results were retained.
lyrics.skipped: Skipped {count} tracks with lyrics or no work due
lyrics.progress: This batch: checked {done}/{total} · Available {found} · No match / instrumental {missing} · Review {review} · Failed {failed}
error.lyricsDisabled: Enable the library before searching for lyrics
error.lyricsBusy: Lyrics search already running or application is stopping
error.lyricsSelection: Select between 1 and 10000 tracks, or all artifacts
error.lyricsConflict: LRC path conflict; unregistered or modified files are preserved
error.lyricsChanged: LRC changed during publication; file preserved
error.lyricsTags: Online lyrics search requires title, artist and a duration between 1 and 3600 seconds
error.lyricsRequest: LRCLIB request failed; check connectivity or retry later

error.lyricsEncoding: LRC must be UTF-8 and no larger than 1 MiB
error.lyricsRegular: LRC must be a regular UTF-8 file no larger than 1 MiB
error.lyricsArtifactChanged: Artifact or library settings changed during lyrics search; result discarded
error.lyricsRebuild: Artifact missing or waiting for rebuild; search again after conversion
error.lyricsArtifactMissing: Playable artifact is no longer available
lyrics.stopHint: Stopping a search also turns off automatic filling.
error.lyricsRetained: No synchronized match found; existing LRC retained
error.lyricsSourceChanged: Source LRC changed while being read; retry
lyrics.chooseNewTab: Choose lyrics (opens in a new tab)
lyrics.instrumentalHint: No vocals? Preview and save a local placeholder LRC.
lyrics.instrumentalSaveHint: Save the placeholder LRC and skip this track during ordinary lyric filling. Existing managed lyrics will be replaced.
lyrics.rawHint: These lyrics could not be parsed as synchronized lyrics. The raw content is for inspection and cannot be saved. Try another candidate, or choose instrumental if there are no vocals.
lyrics.rawUncollected: Provider label: lyrics have not been collected.
lyrics.rawTruncated: The content is too long; only part of the original is shown.
lyrics.trackUnavailable: This track no longer has a playable artifact
lyrics.saveHint: Save a same-name LRC beside this artifact. Managed lyrics may be replaced; edited or unregistered files are preserved.

error.lyricsEmptyQuery: Enter a title or artist to search for lyrics
error.lyricsPreviewFirst: Preview the lyrics candidate before saving
error.lyricsQQRejected: QQ Music rejected the lyrics request
error.lyricsQQInvalid: QQ Music returned invalid lyrics data

error.lyricsProviderData: {provider} returned invalid or oversized lyrics data

error.lyricsPreviewChanged: Lyrics preview changed; select the candidate again

error.lyricsNetEaseGuestExpired: NetEase guest session expired or was rejected; retry later

library.bitratePending: No measured bitrate available. The FLAC header has no compressed bitrate; lightweight refresh preserves existing measurements.
lyrics.selectToPreview: Choose a candidate to preview the lyrics before saving.
lyrics.savedNext: Saved. Continue to another track or close this panel.
lyrics.thresholdHint: Range 0–100; default 96. Used for candidate recommendations, automatic filling and batch replacement; manual saves remain available. Lower scores allow album and duration differences while requiring matching title, artist and version, with at most 10 seconds difference. Conflicts need manual review. Scores are not probabilities; running batches retain their starting settings.
lyrics.batchHint: Library and selected-track filling skip suitable existing lyrics; progress counts only this batch's pending tracks. Changing the threshold never searches completed tracks again. Use a track's Search again to update source LRC changes or restore manually deleted lyrics. Batches use the saved threshold.
lyrics.inspectHint: Already have lyrics from an older version? Run this once to identify their script. It reads managed output LRC files only, without music-tag reads or online searches. Newly saved lyrics are identified automatically.
lyrics.filterTraditional: View traditional lyrics for batch replacement
lyrics.replaceHint: Filter traditional lyrics, select all matching tracks and replace in bulk. Only simplified originals meeting the threshold are adopted; characters are not converted. Missing matches and manually edited files retain their lyrics. Valid cached searches are reused.
audition.title: Artifact audition
audition.noLyrics: No saved output lyrics. Audio can still be auditioned.
audition.lyricsUnavailable: Output lyrics are unavailable or have changed. Audio can still be auditioned.
audition.failed: Cannot play this artifact. The file or session may have changed, or this browser may not support the audio format. Reload to try again.
audition.blocked: Playback was blocked by the browser. Press Play to try again.
audition.damaged: This repaired artifact may contain missing audio, silence or sudden noise.
audition.existing: Playing the existing output artifact; it may differ from the current source or encoding settings.
error.auditionUnavailable: Generated audio is unavailable; reload the library and try again
error.auditionVersion: Audio version is required; reload the audition
maintenance.title: Maintenance workbench
maintenance.hint: Find things worth fixing, preview a build or tidy up output files. Select tracks first to limit a batch.
buildPlan.title: Build preview
buildPlan.estimate: Based on the saved index and encoding profile. VBR sizes are approximate; tags, artwork, temporary output and unknown sizes are excluded. The start action rechecks eligibility.
buildPlan.unverified: {count} unverified tracks need a scan before building.
buildPlan.unknown: {count} tracks have unknown duration and are excluded from the output estimate.
buildPlan.stagingWarning: A source file exceeds the staging limit. Increase MUSICFORGE_STAGING_MAX_BYTES before starting.
quality.title: Library quality report
quality.hint: Choose a category to select its tracks for review or batch work. Counts come from the saved library index.
quality.caution: Duration flags use <10 seconds or >60 minutes. Numbering and duplicate flags are review hints; they never delete or change source files. Covers and lyrics reflect the last saved results.
gain.title: Fill missing loudness tags
gain.hint: Fill missing ReplayGain / R128 tags for players that use them. MusicForge analyzes output albums without re-encoding, keeps existing values and consistent album gain, and follows your schedule and staging limits.
lyricsEdit.title: Edit lyrics / timing
lyricsEdit.hint: Import UTF-8 LRC or edit the text. Positive delay moves lyrics later. Changes preview in the player; Save replaces only this output LRC.
lyricsEdit.fileLimit: Use a UTF-8 LRC file up to 1 MiB.
coverEdit.title: Correct output cover
coverEdit.hint: Applies to cover.jpg in {path}, including tracks sharing that output directory. Multi-disc folders are edited separately. Source artwork is unchanged; the override survives scans.
coverEdit.limit: JPEG / PNG, up to 8 MiB and 4096 pixels per side. Saved as JPEG, at most 1200 pixels per side.
coverEdit.failed: This browser could not process the image.
coverEdit.resetConfirm: Remove this manual override and scan the directory to restore its source cover?
schedule.title: Build scheduling
schedule.hint: Use the configured concurrency inside the window. Outside it, use daytime concurrency; 0 pauses new work. Running work finishes normally. Scans and playback remain available.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Send alerts for exhausted retries, storage offline for five minutes, and less than 256 MiB free on configuration or output storage. Failed deliveries retry after five minutes.
notifications.completion: Also notify when a build batch completes
notifications.savedOnly: Save changes before testing the saved endpoint.
history.title: Version history
history.hint: Your last ten lyric and cover edits are kept here. Preview a version, load it into the editor and save to restore it. Earlier edits are not reconstructed.
coverSearch.title: Find online covers
coverSearch.hint: Search MusicBrainz releases and preview their front cover from Cover Art Archive. Some releases have no cover. Review the source and image before saving.
coverSearch.empty: No releases found. Try another artist name or album title.
coverSearch.loaded: Preview loaded: {width} × {height} px. Save the output cover to apply.
tags.title: Correct output tags
tags.hint: Select tracks in the library, check the fields to change, and preview before applying. Empty checked fields remove that tag. Audio is copied without re-encoding; source files and output paths stay unchanged. Up to 1000 outputs per batch.
tags.previewHint: Previous values come from the saved build index. Each output is verified again before publishing. Corrections are retained for rebuilds of the same indexed source content.
fingerprint.title: Acoustic duplicate candidates
fingerprint.hint: Compare the first 120 seconds of generated audio across tags, containers and bitrates. Results are review clues, including possible false positives; listen before taking action. No files are removed. Cached analysis is reused until the output changes. Choose 2–1000 playable outputs.
playlist.title: Playlists
playlist.hint: Import an M3U/M3U8 playlist or create one from this library scope. Source paths map to current output files, preserving order and repeated entries. Save the mapping to re-export after later builds. Preview and export use only the index.
playlist.name: Playlist name
playlist.base: Imported playlist directory relative to the source root
playlist.limit: Playlist must be UTF-8 and at most 4 MiB.
playlist.location: Place the exported M3U8 in the output library root. Unknown paths, external URLs and tracks without an output are listed separately; they remain in saved mappings for the next export.
error.outputTagFields: Choose at least one output tag to change
error.outputTagText: Output tags must be single-line UTF-8 text, at most 4096 bytes
error.outputTagNumber: Track and disc must be 1–9999, optionally followed by /total
error.outputTagTotal: Track or disc exceeds its total
error.outputTagSelection: Every selected track must have a registered output
error.outputTagPreview: Tag preview expired; preview the changes again
error.coverQuery: Enter an artist and album, at most 500 bytes
error.coverCooldown: Wait a second before searching for covers again
error.coverImage: Cover candidate is not a supported image
error.fingerprintShort: Audio is too short for acoustic comparison
error.fingerprintSilent: Audio has too little non-silent content for acoustic comparison
error.playlistName: Enter a playlist name, at most 160 bytes
error.playlistFormat: Playlist must be UTF-8 M3U, at most 4 MiB and 10000 entries, with a relative base directory
error.playlistLimit: Remove a saved playlist before saving another (limit 50)
review.title: Issue decisions
review.hint: Mark selected issues as to do or ignore them with a reason. Category counts exclude ignored issues; the workbench badge includes all index clues. Decisions apply to the current indexed facts and reopen when those facts change.
review.truncated: Showing the first 100 issues. Selection includes all listed issues, up to 1000 per save.
suggestions.title: Maintenance suggestions
suggestions.hint: Preview actions from the current library scope. This uses the index and starts no tasks. Each track receives one suggestion: build first, then missing lyrics, then loudness tags.
suggestions.confirmHint: Select the actions you want, then explicitly start them. The existing build, lyric and loudness workflows validate each track again.
suggestions.limit: Showing the first 1000 actions. Narrow the library scope to review the rest.
suggestions.started: Selected maintenance actions started; review their progress below or in Jobs / LRC lyrics
suggestions.manual: Metadata, covers, damaged audio and duplicate candidates need review in their existing editors. Suggestions never delete files or replace ready lyrics.
operations.title: Operation records and undo
operations.hint: Recent explicit tag, lyric and cover edits are recorded here (up to 50 batches per library path pair, 1000 items per batch). Preview first, then confirm selected undo actions. Interrupted edits remain visible and require manual review.
operations.empty: No recorded edits for these library paths yet.
operations.conflictHint: Undo restores the previous content and correction policy only while track identity, audio signature and current owned content still match. Conflicts preserve current files and are reported individually.
operations.manual: Restore this item manually through the existing editor or history. Cover resets and edits without a generated audio file do not support automatic undo.
storage.title: Storage health
storage.hint: The overview uses cached state and indexed sizes. Explicit checks inspect mounted directories; checksum verification reads only selected output audio (up to 1000), preserves files and can be stopped.
storage.indexed: Indexed tracks / outputs and cached output bytes
migration.title: Storage migration guide
migration.hint: Check accessible mounted destination paths without copying files or applying settings. Use container paths. Keeping the existing container paths while replacing host mounts also preserves path-bound maintenance records and policies.
migration.checked: Paths checked. Settings have not changed; indexed sizes are estimates and do not verify copied content.
migration.size: Indexed source: {source} B · output: {output} B · destination available: {free} B
migration.owned: The destination output has this instance’s ownership marker; copied files still need verification.
migration.pause: Disable the library and automatic lyric filling, stop active tasks, then stop the MusicForge container.
migration.backup: Create a matching stopped /config backup and output snapshot; retain the original source and output.
migration.copy: Copy source and output, including hidden files and the .musicforge marker. Preserve permissions and verify the copy with your storage tools.
migration.mount: Update host mounts while keeping container paths where possible. Mount source read-only and output read-write. Start MusicForge with the library still disabled.
migration.verify: Check source availability, output ownership and free space; explicitly verify output checksums and audition representative tracks.
migration.resume: After verifying the new mounts, save Settings → Library to acknowledge the source mount, even when container paths stay the same. Preview affected builds before resuming automatic work.
migration.restore: To revert, stop MusicForge and restore the matching configuration backup and output snapshot together. Keep the originals until verification is complete.
error.operationItem: Selected operation item cannot be undone
error.operationTrackConflict: Maintenance undo conflict: track or library changed; current files preserved
error.operationLyricsConflict: Maintenance undo conflict: lyrics changed; current file preserved
error.operationCoverConflict: Maintenance undo conflict: cover changed; current file preserved

progress.hint: Follow lyric, loudness, tag, fingerprint, checksum and undo work here. Scan, conversion and repair queues are below.

failures.title: Failures by cause
failures.hint: Failures are grouped by cause so you can fix one problem and retry just that group. This covers queue items and current lyric failures; other tools keep their own diagnostics.
failures.empty: No current queue or lyric failures.
failures.retryJobs: Retry {count} queue items in this group
failures.retryLyrics: Retry lyrics for {count} tracks in this group
failures.held: Paused, stopped or still active queues are preserved. Resume them through the queue controls.
failures.lyricsLimit: Each lyric retry includes up to 10,000 tracks. Remaining failures stay in this group.
failures.help.permission: Check the container user and permissions on configuration and output directories. Source storage can remain read-only.
failures.help.space: Check output and staging capacity, available space and storage quotas.
failures.help.storage: Check the mount and configured paths. Confirm a replacement source through Settings before retrying.
failures.help.rate_limit: Check source cooldowns and wait until the service is available again.
failures.help.network: Check DNS, connectivity and integration addresses, then retry this group.
failures.help.read: Check the source mount and file readability. Existing output is preserved during unsuccessful reads.
failures.help.decode: Review the full decoder diagnostics and the source file. A decode failure alone does not prove that the source is damaged.
failures.help.encode: Review the encoding settings and encoder diagnostics.
failures.help.validate: Review the output validation diagnostics before retrying the affected tracks.
failures.help.other: Review the task diagnostics or lyric failure details before retrying.
lyrics.sourcesHint: Check the sources you want and move them up or down. Searches follow this order, and it breaks score ties; a higher score still wins. Local source LRC comes first. Save to apply to new searches and batches. Completed tracks stay untouched.
lyrics.japaneseSource: Japanese synchronized lyrics; results without timestamps cannot be saved.
lyrics.amllSource: Community synchronized lyrics, including Japanese. Off by default; missing recording duration requires manual preview and selection.
lyrics.unisonSource: Community synchronized LRC / TTML, including Japanese; plain text is excluded. Off by default.
lyrics.noSources: No online sources are enabled. Filling can still use source LRCs.
error.lyricsProviderDisabled: Lyrics provider is disabled in settings
lyrics.diagnostics.title: Lyric source checks

lyrics.diagnostics.open: View recent searches and check a source
lyrics.diagnostics.checkHint: Choose a track, then check a source. This sends its title and artist to that source; it does not save lyrics or enable the source. A successful search does not guarantee timed lyrics.
lyrics.diagnostics.trackHint: Shows the first 50 matches. Search to narrow the list; a title, artist and duration are required.
lyrics.reason.version: The song version differs (for example, live or instrumental).
lyrics.reason.title: The title does not match.
lyrics.reason.artist: The artist does not match known names or aliases.
lyrics.reason.duration_unknown: There is not enough duration information to confirm the match.
lyrics.reason.duration: The duration differs by more than 10 seconds.
lyrics.reason.album: The album differs or is missing; this lowers the score.
